verdict.rationale: dlt documents automatic schema inference, normalization/unnesting of nested data into typed destination tables (dlt-docs-2, dlt-docs-20, dlt-docs-37), and merge/upsert dedup via primary_key and merge_key (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-35), landing data as queryable structured tables rather than raw JSON (dlt-docs-12, dlt-docs-28). Community feedback corroborates real usage of these features (dlt-comm-1, dlt-comm-2, dlt-comm-3) though one user raises schema-automation trust concerns which speaks to confidence not capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of dedup correctness at scale beyond docs/community anecdotes.
